shots.focal_element: Centred loading spinner with a progress label inside an otherwise blank app window
shots.typography: Native app UI text only: small regular-weight sans-serif in sentence case, normal tracking; no added motion type
shots.what_happens: The floating browser-style app window, framed on a white background with a large blue arc rising from the bottom, shows a page load: a multicoloured spinner turns while its label updates under it; the cursor sits idle top left. Voice-over continues 'key financial statements and metrics of the original working budget' (w339-w346).
shots.build_rebuild: Place a rounded, soft-shadowed app-window screenshot at about 80% width centred over a white stage with a blue circular arc masked in from the bottom edge, and play the raw loading screen capture inside it with no extra animation.

shots.focal_element: Financial statement report table emerging from a dimmed loading overlay
on_screen_text: Reports / What If - Financial Statement & Cash Impact
shots.typography: Native app UI: small sans-serif table text, bold column headers on blue header bands, regular body figures; no added motion type
shots.what_happens: The report view appears first under a dark modal overlay with a small 'Loading...' box, then the overlay lifts to reveal the What If financial statement comparing actuals, budget pass and working budget. Very short (under 1 s); spans w347-w348.
shots.build_rebuild: Inside the same framed window, show the report screenshot with a 70% black overlay and a centred 'Loading...' chip, then remove the overlay on a hard frame to reveal the table.

shots.focal_element: Version 1 / Version 2 selector dropdowns in the report toolbar, with the cursor moving towards them
on_screen_text: Reports / What If - Financial Statement & Cash Impact
shots.typography: Native app UI: dense small sans-serif table, all-caps section labels (INCOME STATEMENT, BALANCE SHEET) in regular weight, bold white column headers on blue bands, link-blue subtotal rows; only the main labels are quoted, the table figures are omitted
shots.what_happens: The full financial statement report is static in the framed window while the cursor travels up to the Version 1 dropdown in the top-left toolbar, setting up the version switch; VO says 'the new May forecast we just created' (w349-w355). An SFX candidate (x004, unsure/swoosh_reverse) falls at 133.51 s inside this shot, with nothing visible to match it.
shots.build_rebuild: Hold the full report screenshot in the centred shadowed window and animate a cursor sprite along an ease-in-out path from mid-table to the Version 1 dropdown over about 1.5 s.

shots.focal_element: Version 2 dropdown list showing 'Working Budget' and 'May Forecast' entries
on_screen_text: Reports / What If - Financial Statement & Cash Impact
shots.typography: Native app UI: small sans-serif dropdown entries, the highlighted row in bold, regular weight elsewhere; tab labels in sentence case; enlarged by the camera zoom rather than restyled
shots.what_happens: The camera is pushed in and offset to the top-left of the window; the user opens the Version 1 dropdown and switches it from Budget Pass 1 to Working Budget, then opens Version 2 and picks May Forecast from a two-item list. The view then pulls back to the full window as the report re-runs: a blank page with a spinner, then a dimmed report under a loading overlay. VO covers w356-w378 ('managers throughout the company can revise their forecasts... slow and painful'). The anchors show 6 events in this shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Scale the framed window to about 1.6x with its transform origin at the toolbar's top-left, play the dropdown-selection capture, then ease the scale back to 1.0 over about 0.6 s as the loading spinner screen begins.

shots.focal_element: Dimmed report table with red and green impact flags behind a 'Loading...' chip
shots.typography: Native app UI: a single small regular sans-serif loading label; the table text underneath is too dimmed to read
shots.what_happens: Brief (about 0.7 s) beat: the re-run report, now comparing Working Budget with May Forecast and showing red and green flags in the Impact column, sits under a dark loading overlay just before it resolves. VO is on 'copy and paste' (w379-w381).
shots.build_rebuild: Show the updated report screenshot in the framed window under a 70% black overlay with a centred 'Loading...' chip for about 16 frames, then hard cut to the next shot.
